attempts.rationale: Robust baseline: median over all 19 models to handle unstable ranking and high error correlation in a trend-dominated series
Trend-dominated series with unstable ranking; inverse_error weights by magnitude rather than rank, complementing the median baseline and handling the 2 independent error groups differently
Robust trimmed mean to handle unstable ranking and high correlation; drops extreme forecasts that diverge from consensus in a trend-dominated series
Diverse subset from 6 different clusters (top performers) to reduce redundancy from the two large correlated groups; tests whether diversity beats full-pool aggregation

DBA optimizes diversity in the combination; tests whether explicitly diversifying among the 6 top-RMSE models (which have mean error correlation 0.911) improves over the simple mean leader in a trend-dominated, unstable-ranking series.
Test if inverse-error weighting within the top-6 pool beats equal-weight mean, exploiting small RMSE differences in a trend-dominated series with unstable ranking
Test SMAPE-selected 7-model pool vs RMSE-selected 6-model pool; different composition may capture complementary trend tracking
Per-horizon top-3 (SMAPE) weighting on pool4: adapts model mix at each step to handle unstable cross-window ranking; distinct from flat mean/weighted leaders
Robust trimmed mean on the 6-model pool4 to test if trimming worst forecasts helps given high error correlation and unstable ranking; different kind from per-horizon weighted leader
Robust median on the 6-model pool4; different central-tendency method than mean/trimmed_mean, suited to unstable ranking and trend-dominated series

Trend-dominated series with unstable ranking; softmax_neg_error gives sharper concentration to best trend-tracking models in pool4, testing whether sharper-than-inverse_error weighting helps vs the topk_per_horizon leader
3-model forward-selected pool (SMAPE criterion) spanning both error-correlation groups; simple mean is robust given unstable ranking and trend-dominated regime

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8988. Series context: trend strength 0.9436 and seasonal strength 0.21; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.076); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.409.
